scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && cd backend && ./mvnw -q dependency:go-offline
scripts.ports:free: lsof -nP -iTCP:27017 -sTCP:LISTEN -t | xargs -r kill; lsof -nP -iTCP:8080 -sTCP:LISTEN -t | xargs -r kill; lsof -nP -iTCP:8081 -sTCP:LISTEN -t | xargs -r kill; lsof -nP -iTCP:5173 -sTCP:LISTEN -t | xargs -r kill; lsof -nP -iTCP:80 -sTCP:LISTEN -t | xargs -r kill
scripts.build: cd backend && ./mvnw -q -DskipTests package && cd ../frontend && npm run build
